name: createReturnsNullWhenTypeNotAssignable
input: clazz = Number.class, typeAdapter = NUMBER, typeToken = TypeToken.get(String.class)
expected: Returns null because String is not assignable from Number (i.e., !clazz.isAssignableFrom(requestedType)).

name: createReturnsAdapterWhenTypeIsAssignable
input: clazz = Number.class, typeAdapter = NUMBER, typeToken = TypeToken.get(Integer.class)
expected: Returns a non-null TypeAdapter because Integer is assignable from Number.

name: createReturnsAdapterWhenTypeExactMatch
input: clazz = Number.class, typeAdapter = NUMBER, typeToken = TypeToken.get(Number.class)
expected: Returns a non-null TypeAdapter because Number is assignable from Number.

name: adapterReadReturnsValidInstanceMatchingRequestedType
input: clazz = Number.class, typeAdapter = NUMBER, reading valid JSON number '42' into Integer.class type token adapter
expected: Reads successfully and returns a LazilyParsedNumber (or whatever typeAdapter.read returns) without throwing since it's compatible or assignable.

name: adapterReadThrowsJsonSyntaxExceptionWhenResultNotInstanceOfRequestedType
input: clazz = Number.class, custom typeAdapter returning a Double when Integer.class is requested via TypeToken
expected: Throws JsonSyntaxException because result != null and !requestedType.isInstance(result).

name: adapterReadReturnsNullSafelyWithoutTypeCheckWhenResultIsNull
input: clazz = Number.class, typeAdapter returning null on read (e.g. JSON null), requestedType = Integer.class
expected: Returns null without throwing JsonSyntaxException because result is null (skipped check).

name: adapterWriteDelegatesToTypeAdapterCorrectly
input: clazz = Number.class, typeAdapter = NUMBER, writing integer value 100
expected: Delegates successfully to typeAdapter.write without errors.

name: createWithInterfaceHierarchyMatch
input: clazz = Appendable.class, typeAdapter = STRING_BUILDER (subclass/implementor), typeToken = TypeToken.get(StringBuilder.class)
expected: Returns non-null TypeAdapter because StringBuilder implements Appendable (clazz.isAssignableFrom(requestedType) is true).

name: adapterReadSucceedsWhenResultIsExactSubclassInstance
input: clazz = Number.class, typeAdapter returning LazilyParsedNumber, requestedType = Number.class
expected: Returns the LazilyParsedNumber successfully because LazilyParsedNumber is an instance of Number.
